senses.gloss:
mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Relating or appertaining to the god ŚIVA.
m. (-वः)
A worshipper of ŚIVA.
n. (-वं)
An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra).
E.
शिव the deity, and अण् aff.

m. (-लः)
An aquatic plant.
n. (-लं)
A drug, commonly termed Padamkāṭh.
E.
शी to sleep, (on the water,) वलञ् aff.; also शैवाल, शेवाल, &c.

m. (-लः)
An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.)
E.
शी to sleep, (on the water,) वालन् aff., शेवाल, and अण् pleonasm.

f. (-नी)
A river in general.
E.
शैवल Vallisneria, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-वी-व्यं)
Relating to ŚIVA, &c.
m. (-व्यः)
1 One of the horses of KṚṢṆA car.
2 A king and champion in the Pāṇḍava army.
E.
शिव, and यञ् aff.
